r1.text: Arrows move. Z jumps (hold for higher).
r1.touch: The pad moves. JUMP jumps (hold for higher).

r1.text: Press UP at a bench to rest and save.
r1.touch: Push the pad up at a bench to rest and save.

r1.text: Hold DOWN + X in the air to pogo off enemies.
r1.touch: Pad down + ATK in the air to pogo off enemies.

r4.text: Push into a wall and press Z to wall jump.
r4.touch: Push into a wall and press JUMP to wall jump.

r5.text: Hold D to heal with your song.
r5.touch: Hold HEAL to heal with your song.

r6.text: Cracked stone. Something explosive might help.

r7.text: A sealed door. It needs a key.
